svg.aria-label: Final architecture from chapter 1: users get static files from a CDN and an IP from geoDNS, then call a load balancer in front of stateless web servers. Session state lives in a NoSQL store, a cache sits in front of sharded master/replica databases, a message queue feeds workers, and logging and automation cover everything. The data center is replicated across regions.
svg.title: Chapter 1 final architecture
